title: Peg Abandonment and Cross-Currency Contagion
authors: Florian Balke; Andreas Barth; Arne Reichel; Mark Wahrenburg
eligible_reason: Single event date: prepost = tradetime > td(15jan2015) for all quote requests (Swiss National Bank abandons the EUR/CHF floor), diffindiff = treatedccy (DKK and other pegged-currency pairs) x prepost. One adoption cohort, so not staggered. All columns also include the time-varying request-level control lnnotional and provider-requester-month / provider-day FE on request-level quote data; the event study (pre_k/post_k weekly bins x treated) is around the same single date.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe on FX swap quote requests (fx_data_all.dta), Dec 1 2014 - Feb 28 2015, event day dropped. Main: reghdfe provider_spread treatedccy prepost diffindiff lnnotional if on==1, absorb(provider_day provider_requester_month ccypair yearendccy) vce(cluster provider); weekly-bin event study reghdfe lnspread100 treatedccy pre_7_treated..post_7_treated lnnotional, absorb(provider_requester_month ...). Placebo/robustness variants by sample window (on/onew/onem/threem), executed quotes, winsorized spreads.
data_files_note: Main dealer-quote dataset shipped; Bloomberg market-swap raw data (appendix figure) not provided.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Single common treatment date (Jan 15, 2015); not staggered.
